quiz.question_id: Mengapa perlu membuat wrapper responseWriter untuk menangkap status code di logging middleware?
quiz.question_en: Why do you need to wrap ResponseWriter to capture the status code in logging middleware?
options_id: http.ResponseWriter tidak menyimpan status code setelah dikirim, perlu dicapture
Agar status code bisa diubah setelah dikirim
options_en: http.ResponseWriter doesn't store the status code after sending; it needs to be captured
So the status code can be changed after sending
Because the default status code is always 0

quiz.question_id: Apa yang dimaksud dengan CORS preflight request?
quiz.question_en: What is a CORS preflight request?
options_id: Request OPTIONS yang dikirim browser sebelum request aktual untuk memeriksa izin
Request yang gagal dan perlu dicoba ulang
options_en: An OPTIONS request sent by the browser before the actual request to check permissions
The first request when the server starts
A request to check server health
A failed request that needs retry
